frase_inicial: Michael: let’s go step by step to protect your cash for the house and retirement

tarjetas.reverso: If you set aside the home down payment and vacation from the same accounts you use for everyday bills, you may need to sell investments or borrow. Start by separating the money you intend for the house.
tarjetas.detalle: Current accessible cash $30,000; short-term needs for home + vacation $116,800; adjusted cash target $163,330–$172,636.

tarjetas.frente: Retirement won’t last to your plan end
tarjetas.reverso: At your planned retirement age, savings are projected to run out before your plan ends, so some future spending would be unpaid unless you change saving or the plan timing.
tarjetas.detalle: Savings projected to run out at age 85; retirement gap ~ $1,177,586; required extra savings about $20,231/yr.

tarjetas.frente: Life and liability protection need attention
tarjetas.reverso: Your current life cover and lack of umbrella leave your income and savings exposed if something happens. Confirm actual car insurance next, then compare adding extra liability cover.
tarjetas.detalle: Life insurance $180,000; recommended minimum $900,000. Umbrella gap $1,000,000.

tarjetas.frente: The credit card is the most expensive debt
tarjetas.reverso: That card costs the most to carry. Paying it faster lowers your monthly interest drain, but it competes with building the house cash and retirement saving.
tarjetas.detalle: Amex balance $3,500 at 20% APR, $200 monthly payment, projected payoff July 2028.

tarjetas.frente: Your saving habit is a real strength
tarjetas.reverso: You already save steadily and capture the full employer match. That gives options: rebuild cash, slow a bit of long-term saving, or shift investments after the house decision.
tarjetas.detalle: You save $43,000/year including $7,000 employer match; 401(k) contributions active.

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: Adding liability cover raises your protection quickly and shields your cash and savings from a big claim, which is important before the house purchase.
pasos: Open your insurer’s app or call your renter insurance company
Ask for a quote for an extra liability policy of $1,000,000 that sits on top of your renter policy
Save the quote and comparison to decide with your budget
